description: This file appears to be a module index file that exports various functions and classes related to handling tar archives within a Node.js project. It provides high-level commands and class exports for creating, replacing, listing, updating, extracting archives, as well as classes for packing, unpacking, parsing, reading, writing entries, handling headers and pax headers, and managing types.
